sloka: महान्ति कूटानि मही धराणाम्धारा विधौतानि अधिकम् विभान्ति ।महा प्रमाणैः विपुलैः प्रपातैःमुक्त कलापैः इव लंबमानैः ॥४-२८-४८॥
transliteration: mahānti kūṭāni mahī dharāṇāmdhārā vidhautāni adhikam vibhānti ।mahā pramāṇaiḥ vipulaiḥ prapātaiḥmukta kalāpaiḥ iva laṁbamānaiḥ ॥4-28-48॥

translations.english: 'The huge mountain peaks are washed by the heavy downpour of rain which look like long strings of pearls hanging.
